title: 第47章 造船图纸
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
翁知远还以为自己听错了，迟疑道：“大船的建造图纸？”

谭筝点头：“没错，我想请你帮忙设计、绘制能容纳多人的大船。”

“小筝，要那玩意干啥啊？你想出海啊？就算真的要出海，咱们租一条不行吗？犯得着自个倒腾吗？”谭仲霖也有些迷糊了。

翁知远急忙推辞：“我平日里不过做些小玩意，哪里懂造

猎鹰心跳一阵加速，急忙展开双翅转身在开阔的地下室里飞旋。霹雳火就像发现了猎物时欣喜的猎人一样，穷追不舍。

这话说出去，估计很难让人相信的吧。而且在看着林风这质彬彬，白白净净的样子。不管怎么说，都不像是双手沾满着血腥的人呀。

既是穷凶极恶的逃犯，姚真的失踪与他相关到成了顺理成章的事，红笺长这么大除了那天在寰华殿目睹刑无涯当众处死了高鸿信，还没怎么经历过修真界的凶恶残酷，这实在叫她很难相信。

虽然能量让那些伤口慢慢痊愈了，但毕竟只是将血止住，只要这圣龙有太大的举动，那伤口同样会破裂。

万贤来和奚旭本已各自迎向一只元婴期的“蝎尾海狮”，猛见“鬼面鹅”那边是神识攻击，只得先腾出手来对付。

原本，他是坐在石凳上面，下一刻，化为一道残影，出现在了四丈之外，双手的手臂在虚空缓慢的运行，像是在画太极图。

布雷德心底一沉，知道自己已经暴露，脚下一错，如风似电地极速冲出了指挥室。

“菲尔，难道你有什么其他的想法么？哼~你以为你能怎么样？”青藤二话不说，运起了全身的修为，恶狠狠地盯着菲尔，显然，她现在先天期的实力，对菲尔来说，还是有着一定的威慑力的。

就在这极为危急的关头，两把血红色长匕首无声无息的从契科夫的背后旋转的斩过，正面与洛克控制的残破刀片狠狠的碰撞在一起。空气中瞬间就出现了无数声刺耳的斩击碰撞声。

林天就纳闷了，自己这修为，似乎不是很够看么？可是佛祖你这又是几个意思，难道是故意给自己压力么？

时间也没浪费多久，最新款的奔驰轿跑s级。鲜艳的红色，跟张雅哪一样是完全一样，价格两百万不到。

她起身穿上鞋，随便糊了把脸就一屁股坐在了梳妆台前，一副没睡醒的样子。

等梅若彤把下午那件事情的真相简单说了一遍之后，梅臻阳的神情已经不能简单地用愤怒来形容了。

只是这样的话，他张宝还得率领士兵在此死守，这可就有点麻烦了。

张妈妈吩咐完了以后，就开始跟沈幼清解释，这到底是怎么一回事了。

“当然！相比起我们人类来说，灵的晋升更为艰难，所以每一次晋升，都会获得极大幅度的提升——毕竟那是一整个世界的力量。”男子道。

程耀坐在沙发上，玩着手机看着两人交头接耳，张雅手把手教学认真的样子，觉得挺温馨的。

同时也实实在在的觉得，沈幼清这一番话，激励了士气，同时也的确是现在大周这边的将士们，应该有的正确想法。

老王也没难为人，没再说什么，他也是听说程耀厉害，所以就来试试。

“做什么露出这么一副委屈的样子来呢？”沈幼清却秉持着“不依不饶”的“良好习惯”，嗔怪着说完以后，就转过头去，一副懒得看李宓的样子。
content_en:
Weng Zhiyuan thought he heard wrongly and asked hesitantly: "The construction drawings of the big ship?"

Tan Zheng nodded: "Yes, I would like to ask you to help design and draw a large ship that can accommodate many people."

"Xiao Zheng, what do you need that thing for? Do you want to go to sea? Even if you really want to go to sea, can't we rent one? Do you have to make the trouble on your own?" Tan Zhonglin was also a little confused.

Weng Zhiyuan hurriedly declined: "I just make small gadgets on weekdays. How can I know how to make them?"

Falcon's heartbeat quickened, and he quickly spread his wings and turned around to fly in the open basement.The Human Torch was like a hunter rejoicing when he found his prey, pursuing it relentlessly.

When you say this, it’s probably hard for people to believe it.And he was looking at Lin Feng's elegant and fair appearance.No matter what, he doesn't look like someone with bloody hands.

Since he was a vicious fugitive, it was natural that Yao Zhen's disappearance was related to him. Hong Jian had not experienced much of the ferocious cruelty of the world of cultivation except for witnessing Xing Wuya execute Gao Hongxin in public that day at the Huanhua Palace. This was really hard for her to believe.

Although the energy slowly healed those wounds, it only stopped the bleeding. As long as the holy dragon made too big a move, the wounds would also burst.

Wan Xianlai and Xi Xu were already facing a "Scorpion-tailed Sea Lion" in the Nascent Soul stage. Suddenly, they saw that the "Ghost-faced Goose" was attacking with their spiritual consciousness, so they had to free their hands to deal with it first.

Originally, he was sitting on the stone bench. The next moment, he turned into an afterimage and appeared four feet away. His arms moved slowly in the void, as if he was drawing a Tai Chi diagram.

Brad's heart sank, knowing that he had been exposed. He slipped his foot and rushed out of the command room as fast as wind and lightning.

"Phil, do you have any other ideas?Huh~ What do you think you can do?"Qingteng didn't say anything, and used all her cultivation to stare at Phil fiercely. Obviously, her current innate strength still has a certain deterrent effect on Phil.

At this extremely critical moment, two blood-red long daggers whirled past Chekov's back silently, and collided fiercely with the broken blade controlled by Locke.There were countless harsh sounds of slashing and collisions in the air instantly.

Lin Tian was puzzled. Doesn't his cultivation seem to be impressive?But Buddha, what do you mean by this? Are you deliberately putting pressure on yourself?

Time was not wasted long, the latest Mercedes-Benz Coupe S-Class is here.The bright red color is exactly the same as Zhang Ya's, and the price is less than two million.

She got up and put on her shoes, wiped her face casually, and sat down in front of the dressing table, looking like she hadn't woken up.

After Mei Ruotong briefly told the truth about what happened that afternoon, Mei Zhenyang's expression could no longer simply be described as angry.

But in this case, Zhang Bao would have to lead his soldiers to defend here, which would be a bit troublesome.

After Mother Zhang finished her instructions, she began to explain to Shen Youqing what was going on.

"Of course!Compared with us humans, spiritual promotion is more difficult, so every promotion will result in a huge improvement - after all, it is the power of an entire world."The man said.

Cheng Yao was sitting on the sofa, playing with his mobile phone and watching the two of them whispering to each other. Zhang Ya was teaching carefully, which made him feel very warm.

At the same time, I really felt that Shen Youqing's words had boosted morale, and they were indeed the correct thoughts that the soldiers on Da Zhou's side should have now.

Lao Wang was not embarrassed and didn't say anything. He also heard that Cheng Yao was good, so he came to give it a try.

"Why do you look so aggrieved?" Shen Youqing, however, upheld the "good habit" of "not giving in and not giving in". After saying this in annoyance, she turned her head away, as if she was too lazy to look at Li Mi.
